column1: # Bridge overrides (owner decisions 2026-10-20, ../bridges/DECISIONS.md and PLAN.md). Override mapping.tsv for these CS1 segments only.

#   plan    fixed:<span,...> (exact spans, fixedIndex per edge) | count:<n> (n equal straight edges per chain) | span:<max m> (fewest equal edges ≤ max)
#           ;merge = BR001 carriageway merge onto one two-way centreline; ;fixedfile = written to import-bridges-fixed.json (off by default)
#   seg     m_SegmentLength (m) for the 0.6–1.4 × seg rule; [U] = assumed (vanilla values are not readable offline; bridges/cs2-bridge-rules.json will replace them)
#   alt     kept alternative (prefab | plan), not used; swap it into prefab/plan to try it
